hero.headlineLine1: Virtual data rooms for M&A teams and founders
hero.subtext: Run M&A diligence rooms and founder investor data rooms with gated links, dynamic watermarking, download controls, and privacy-first analytics. Start free for PDF sharing, then upgrade as deal or fundraising volume grows.

features.title: Deal rooms built for M&A and founder diligence
features.description: Set up client-facing rooms for sell-side, buy-side, investor, and diligence workflows your team can reuse across processes.

features.title: Secure sharing controls by default
features.description: Control who can open, download, and revisit sensitive documents with email verification, allowlists, expirations, NDA gates, and room-level access rules.

features.title: Watermarking and redaction for sensitive files
features.description: Deter casual leaks in deal, investor, and legal packets with dynamic watermarking and permanent PDF redaction through DocKosha Cloud’s validated processing path, before documents leave your organization.

features.title: Privacy-first analytics for follow-up
features.description: See views, time per page, downloads, and engagement across deal, investor, and legal review without defaulting to unnecessary identity collection.

features.title: High-fidelity room and document viewing
features.description: Present CIMs, pitch decks, contracts, models, board packs, and diligence files in a viewer that stays consistent across desktop and mobile through DocKosha Cloud’s validated processing path.

features.title: Free secure sharing for lighter use
features.description: Use the Free plan for PDF-first document sharing when a full room is not needed yet, then move to paid tiers as deal, fundraising, or legal needs grow.

features.title: Version history without link churn
features.description: Replace files and keep a clean version trail without breaking links already shared with customers, partners, or reviewers.

features.title: Audit logs for internal accountability
features.description: Keep an owner-only audit trail of uploads, renames, link changes, and access updates across documents and data rooms.
